description: Figure: AlphaFold confidence profile of IRG-2 and TM-scores of best Foldseek matches per database
code:
import requests, json, time
import numpy as np, pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.patches as mpatches

pdbtxt=requests.get("https://alphafold.ebi.ac.uk/files/AF-O16224-F1-model_v6.pdb",timeout=60).text
plddt=np.array([float(l[60:66]) for l in pdbtxt.splitlines() if l.startswith("ATOM") and l[12:16].strip()=="CA"])
resn=np.arange(1,len(plddt)+1)

tm=pd.read_csv("/tmp/tm_scores.csv") if False else None
# recompute table from stored csv written in previous cell is not persistent; re-derive from literal results
data=[("afdb50 / afdb-proteome (C. elegans paralog O16222 C49G7.10)",0.727,1.19e-27,True),
      ("afdb50 (C. remanei A0A6A5GGM3)",0.706,1.51e-28,True),
      ("afdb50 (C. briggsae A0AAE8ZV55)",0.697,5.19e-30,True),
      ("afdb-proteome (C. elegans B1GRK2 C49G7.7)",0.674,1.91e-25,True),
      ("afdb-proteome (C. elegans B1GRK3 C49G7.12)",0.654,9.17e-24,True),
      ("afdb50 (C. brenneri G0NHN2 C49G7.10)",0.651,2.20e-28,True),
      ("afdb-proteome (C. elegans Q9BI97 F17C11.11)",0.619,2.73e-20,True),
      ("afdb50 (C. remanei A0A260ZNQ6)",0.618,1.84e-27,True),
      ("afdb-proteome (C. elegans Q9N5I0 K09D9.1)",0.616,4.65e-23,True),
      ("cath50 best (T. cruzi Q4DRE9, 3.40.140.10)",0.195,2.75e0,False),
      ("mgnify_esm30 best (MGYP000848340890)",0.154,1.14e0,False),
      ("bfvd best (VZV UL24 homolog G0ZLD7)",0.132,8.50e0,False),
      ("afdb-swissprot best non-nematode (MJ0365)",0.114,4.22e0,False),
      ("pdb100 best (DNA pol 6isg/4fly)",0.107,6.50e0,False),
      ("pdb100 2nd (DnaK-GrpE 4ani_D)",0.102,3.27e0,False)]
t=pd.DataFrame(data,columns=['label','TM','eval','nematode']).sort_values('TM')

fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(16,6.2),gridspec_kw={'width_ratios':[1,1.25]})

ax=axes[0]
ax.plot(resn,plddt,color='#1f4e79',lw=1.4)
ax.axhline(70,color='#888',ls='--',lw=1); ax.axhline(90,color='#bbb',ls=':',lw=1)
ax.fill_between(resn,0,100,where=(resn>=70)&(resn<=197),color='#ffd27f',alpha=.35)
ax.text(133,8,'Pfam PF28668 IRG2_N (70-197)',ha='center',fontsize=9,color='#7a5600')
ax.set_xlabel('Residue'); ax.set_ylabel('pLDDT')
ax.set_title('AF-O16224-F1 (IRG-2) model confidence\nmean pLDDT 68.7; 45% of residues below 70',fontsize=11)
ax.set_ylim(0,100); ax.set_xlim(1,278)

ax=axes[1]
cols=['#2a7f62' if n else '#b03a2e' for n in t.nematode]
ax.barh(range(len(t)),t.TM,color=cols)
ax.set_yticks(range(len(t))); ax.set_yticklabels(t.label,fontsize=8)
ax.axvline(0.5,color='k',ls='--',lw=1.2)
ax.text(0.505,0.3,'TM = 0.5, same-fold threshold',rotation=90,fontsize=8,va='bottom')
ax.set_xlabel('TM-score of the Foldseek alignment, normalised by IRG-2 length (278)')
ax.set_title('Best Foldseek structural matches to IRG-2 by database\ngreen: nematode IRG2_N family; red: best non-nematode hit per database',fontsize=11)
ax.set_xlim(0,1.0)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
print(t.to_string(index=False))
